description: Inject into Neo4j Cypher queries to bypass auth, exfiltrate graph data, and reach SSRF/RCE. Load when user input reaches a Cypher query (Neo4j-backed app, GraphQL/REST over a graph DB) — a login, search, or filter that builds `MATCH (n {prop:'<input>'})`. Signals: Neo4j/Bolt (7687), `MATCH`/ `RETURN` in errors, `neo4j` cookies/stack traces, apoc procedures, a graph-backed search field.
